title: Trump: Former Trump executive releases book detailing racism & stupidity
description_short: Trump: Former Trump executive releases book detailing racism & stupidity
description_medium: John R. O’Donnell, a former Trump Plaza Hotel and Casino executive, published Trumped! The Inside Story of the Real Donald Trump in 1991. The linked archive reproduces selected passages from a New York Times review that summarized O’Donnell’s claims about Trump’s remarks and business conduct. Those accounts are attributed allegations; the archive does not provide the full book or review.
description_long: John R. O’Donnell, a former president of Trump Plaza Hotel and Casino, published Trumped! The Inside Story of the Real Donald Trump in 1991. The linked archive reproduces selected passages from a New York Times review published on July 14, 1991. According to the excerpts, the review discussed O’Donnell’s claims about racist remarks concerning Black accountants and his descriptions of Trump’s response to a 1989 helicopter crash and casino spending. The claims are O’Donnell’s account as summarized by a reviewer, not independently established facts. The archive does not provide the full review, the underlying book pages or a precise book-release date. Its timeline labels the event May 1, but the cited review appeared later that summer; that does not establish the exact publication day. The material supports describing the book’s release in 1991 and the controversy around O’Donnell’s allegations, while keeping each claim attributed. A library or publisher record and the complete review would be needed to confirm the date and examine the quotations in context.

title: Trump: Mogilevich & BNY caught in largest money-laundering scheme in U.S. history
description_short: Trump: Mogilevich & BNY caught in largest money-laundering scheme in U.S. history
